name: kaleidoscope
prompt: Kaleidoscope pattern with a segments setting (3, 4, 6, or 8 — use a switch on it) and slow rotation.

provenance.via: claude --print with the in-app agent instructions (no Powermove MCP tools)

summary: The kaleidoscope shader layer is written but not compiled or rendered, because no live Powermove tools were attached to this run. A `switch` rounds `uSegments` to 3, 4, 6 or 8 mirrored segments (5 becomes 6 and 7 becomes 8). The whole pattern rotates slowly with `uRotSpeed` (default 0.08 rad/s). You can also adjust `uZoom` (pattern scale), `uFlow` (how fast the pattern drifts) and the two colours `uColorA`/`uColorB` in the Inspector.
